label: Find a Tender
terms_note: OGL v3.0; anonymous; no rate limit on the page.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** for discovery (OCDS release/record package APIs). Lane `assist` → **api for search**. Confidence high.

endpoints.notes: OCDS releases: tender.title, description, value, tenderPeriod.endDate, buyer

reference.limits: - OGL v3.0; bids on buyer portals. - OGL v3.0; anonymous; no rate limit on the page.

adapter.rate_note: No numeric limit published; the API pages document HTTP 429 with Retry-After ('no further requests should be made until after the number of seconds specified in the Retry-After header value') and 503 with the same guidance. Anonymous; data under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

search_postings.note: OCDS release package API: documented parameters are limit (default and max 100), cursor, updatedFrom, updatedTo (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) and stages (planning, tender, award). `stages=tender` is fixed; there is no keyword parameter, so `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are not sent (filter client-side). Paging is by cursor, which page/limit cannot carry: `page` is ignored and only the first `limit` releases are returned. `id` is the OCDS ocid (ocds-h6vhtk-…) accepted by get_posting.

get_posting.note: `id` is the procurement ocid ('ocds-h6vhtk-hhhhhh', e.g. /api/1.0/ocdsRecordPackages/ocds-h6vhtk-000cb9); the record package's compiledRelease is mapped (tender{title, description, value, tenderPeriod}, buyer{name}). 404 when the procurement is not found.

not_offered.submit_bid: Page: 'bids on buyer portals' — Find a Tender is the notice board; there is no bid, message or account API.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
